close_reason: Already documented: IdFate enum doc at line 162 says 'created+destroyed → removed from map', and line 350-352 has inline comment explaining RFC 8620 §5.2 requirement.
description: tests/common/mod.rs IdFate implements the RFC 8620 §5.6 change deduplication rules. Crucially, when an object is created then destroyed within the same /changes window it is removed from the fates map entirely (not reported as Destroyed). The client never knew the object existed, so reporting it as Destroyed would be incorrect. A future contributor might change the Created→Destroyed case to insert IdFate::Destroyed, which would send spurious notDestroyed entries to the client. The omit-from-map behavior on line 271 is correct and required by the spec.
title: IdFate created+destroyed in window produces no entry per RFC 8620 §5.6
